caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored, life-like statue of a reclining dog, likely a greyhound, positioned on a rectangular base. The dog is shown in profile facing left, with its front legs extended forward and its hind legs tucked beneath its body. The dog's form is slim, and the ribs are visible, highlighting its lean physique. The color of the statue is a gradient of dark gray to almost black, with subtle brownish highlights and speckled spots, especially around the legs and body, indicating some texture or weathering. The rectangular base on which the dog rests is light gray with clean edges. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a small inset schematic outline of the statue, labeled with the dimensions "2 1/2" for height and "5" for length, indicating the scale of the depicted object. The artist's note "J.B. Moll Jr. 2594 Del." is inscribed in small text at the bottom left of the drawing. The composition is centered within a simple rectangular border, and the background is a plain, uncolored beige or off-white.
title: Greyhound
